_meta.title: MySmartHome tariff schema (Latvia / Riga)
_meta.author: tariff-model-agent
_meta.status: TEMPLATE — all live values are null until the owner fills them from the contract/invoice
rules: Never invent a rate. Unknown => null, NEVER 0.
While any layer-2/3/4 value is null, the system must show ONLY the spot cost.
UI label while spot-only: «Стоимость Nord Pool». NEVER «Итоговый счёт».
Nord Pool spot price is read live from sensor.nord_pool_lv_current_price (EUR/kWh, 15-min). It is NOT stored here.
spot_only is true whenever any required add-on (supplier_markup, distribution, transmission, electricity_tax, vat) is null.

1_nord_pool_spot.description: Wholesale market price, priced per 15-min interval at the price in force. Read live, not stored.
1_nord_pool_spot.value: LIVE — from Home Assistant, not a stored constant

2_variable_addons.description: Per-kWh charges added on top of the spot price. All EUR/kWh, VAT-exclusive.

day_night.description: OPTIONAL. Only fill if the owner is on a time-of-use (dienas/nakts) distribution plan. If used, these OVERRIDE distribution_eur_per_kwh for the given hours. Leave all null for a flat/single tariff.

3_vat.description: Value added tax (PVN), applied to (spot + all variable add-ons) and to fixed charges. LV standard is 21% but must be owner-confirmed — kept null until confirmed.

4_fixed_charges.description: Standing charges independent of consumption (capacity/power maintenance, supplier service fee). VAT-exclusive.

5_full_estimated_bill.description: How the full bill is composed once layers 2-4 are provided. Purely a formula spec; produces null while spot_only is true.
5_full_estimated_bill.note: If ANY input above is null, full_estimated_bill = null and the system reports/labels the visible figure as «Стоимость Nord Pool» (spot only).
